# ADR-002: Spring Boot 4.1 instead of 3.5

- **Status:** Proposed
- **Date:** 2026-10-11
- **Deciders:** human (+ AI proposal, architect subagent)

## Context CLAUDE.md fixes Spring Boot 4.1 / Security 7 / Jackson 3 / Kotlin 2.3 / Java 25. Most AI training data is Boot 3, so the agent risks generating outdated APIs (`com.fasterxml.jackson.databind`, `@MockBean`, `.and()`, monolithic starters). The Boot 3.5 OSS support window (verify the exact end date on spring.io) ends before or around the submission date.

## Decision Use Spring Boot 4.1.x as generated by start.spring.io (default 4.1.1), Java 25 toolchain, and the modular starters. Follow CLAUDE.md §9. When unsure of an API, check the sources JAR or docs, or write "verify".

## Alternatives considered

| Option | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|
| Boot 3.5 / Jackson 2 | AI agents are fluent in it; many examples | Near or past OSS end of life; contradicts CLAUDE.md stack |
| Boot 4.1 | Current, supported; JSpecify nullability; RestTestClient; virtual threads | Modular starters can "silently do nothing"; higher risk of API hallucination |

## Consequences
- (+) Supported, current baseline.
- (−) Extra verification per dependency, e.g. Testcontainers 2 artifact names, health additional-path, the Prometheus endpoint starter.
- Any library whose Boot-4-compatible version is unverified (springdoc, springmockk) is avoided.
